entities.name: Saffi Eriksdotter
entities.description: Balduvian scout of the Ice Age on Dominaria, killed by a Lhurgoyf and possibly revived by a Sun Titan.

entities.name: Hans Eriksson
entities.description: Saffi's brother, who escaped the attack to warn the villagers.

entities.name: Sun Titan
